sections.label: Ecosystem
sections.title: Ecosystem
sections.intro: Satellite analysis of the mangrove forest at Sisal, Yucatán, 1993–2025. Maps show where the forest has grown, thinned or been lost. An early-warning analysis at {total} sample locations tests whether parts of it are approaching a tipping point.

parts.title: Mangrove maps
parts.intro: Vegetation data from Landsat and Sentinel-2 imagery across the full mangrove area. Three layers: extent, condition, disturbance and recovery.

parts.title: NDVI
parts.intro: Monthly NDVI of {total} monitoring points. Click one of the {featured} larger markers to see its raw NDVI and deseasonalised STL trend.

parts.title: Tipping points & Early Warning Signals
parts.intro: Breakpoints and early warning signals. Click a larger marker to see whether that point had a lasting loss, and whether there was a warning before it.

parts.title: Storms at Sisal
parts.intro: All {total} tropical storms that passed near Sisal between {start} and {end}, and the {studied} of them that we study in detail with daily climate data.

parts.title: Climate at Sisal
parts.intro: For each variable: what a typical year looks like, and how it has changed since 1950.

wide.title: Climate overview
wide.note: Click a variable name to see it in detail.
